cues.en: and the answer ended up being the hundred-year flood

cues.en: an often misunderstood combination of statistical hydrology

cues.zh: 和社会风险容忍度
cues.en: and societal risk tolerance

cues.zh: 顺便说一句，这是我最喜欢的两个话题，但它其实是个相当简单的概念
cues.en: two of my favorite topics by the way, but it's actually a pretty simple concept

cues.zh: 百年一遇洪水是指溪流中特定大小的流量，而一百年是其重现期
cues.en: the hundred year flood is a particular magnitude of flow in a creek , and a hundred years is its return period

cues.zh: 重现期的倒数是年超越概率
cues.en: The inverse of return period is annual exceedence probability

cues.zh: 所以百年一遇洪水的年超越概率是1%
cues.en: So a hundred year flood has an annual exceedence probability of 1%

cues.zh: 假设我们的百年一遇风暴是每秒10,000立方英尺的流量。
cues.en: let's say our hundreds of your storm is a flow of 10,000 cubic feet per second.

cues.zh: 也就是说，在特定一年里，有1%
cues.en: That means in a given year. There's a 1%

cues.zh: 的概率会发生流量达到或超过10,000 CFS的洪水
cues.en: Probability that a flow of 10,000 CFS or greater will occur

cues.zh: 用重现期来表述会误导人，因为它让风暴听起来像是周期性的
cues.en: Using our return period is misleading because it makes storm sound cyclical

cues.zh: 它暗示我们有可能预测未来
cues.en: It hints that the possibility that we could predict the future

cues.zh: 仿佛只要发生某个特定量级的风暴，之后就会有一段安全期，直到它再次发生
cues.en: That somehow if a storm of a particular magnitude was to occur that we might have a period of security before it happened again

cues.zh: 甚至暗示如果很久没发生大洪水，我们就比刚发生过时更“该”遇到它了
cues.en: or even that if a major flood had not occurred in quite some time that we might be more due for it to occur than if it

cues.zh: 刚发生过时更“该”遇到它了
cues.en: Had happened recently

cues.zh: 你不会把掷出双幺称为“36次掷骰”，也不会把葫芦称为“700次发牌”
cues.en: You don't call Snake Eyes the 36 roll dice throw and you don't call a full house the 700 deal poker ham

cues.zh: 所以如果去年发生了百年一遇的洪水，今年仍有1%的概率再次发生
cues.en: So if 100-year flood occurred last year, there's still a 1% chance that it could happen this year

cues.zh: 事实上，许多水文学家已经完全不再使用重现期，而是直接用年超越概率来称呼洪水规模
cues.en: In fact many hydrologists has stopped using return period altogether in favor of just calling flood magnitudes by their annual exceedence probability

cues.zh: 就是为了避免这种让人误以为风暴有某种日程表的混淆概念
cues.en: Just to avoid this confusing notion that storms are on some kind of schedule

cues.zh: 所以回到之前的问题：洪泛区就是可以合理预期
cues.en: So to answer our question from before the flood plain is the area of land that can reasonably be expected

cues.zh: 取你朋友或同事群体中所有男性或女性的身高
cues.en: Take the height of all the men or women in your group of friends or office

cues.zh: 我们知道身高呈正态分布，这种变化符合这种在自然界中无处不在的特定分布形态
cues.en: We know that height is normally distributed the variation fits this particular shape of distribution that is ubiquitous in the natural world

cues.zh: 要将你的数据拟合到正态分布
cues.en: To fit your data to a normal distribution

cues.zh: 你只需要知道平均身高和标准差，这两个都是简单的公式
cues.en: The only thing you need to know is the average height and the standard deviation and these are both simple formulas

cues.zh: 你测量身高的那些人是一个样本，而分布能帮你用样本刻画整个总体
